arxiv-2207-00613.creator: Michael Anshelevich, Austin Pritchett
arxiv-2207-00613.description: Abstract . For two matrices A A and B B , and large n n , we show that most products of n n factors of e A / n e^{A/n} and n n factors of e B / n e^{B/n} are close to e A + B e^{A+B} . This extends the Lie-Trotter formula.

arxiv-2208-06443.title: Photobombing Earth 2.0: Diffraction Limit Related Contamination and Uncertainty in Habitable Planet Spectra
arxiv-2208-06443.creator: Prabal Saxena
arxiv-2208-06443.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Prabal Saxena. Observing habitable exoplanets that may resemble Earth is a key priority in astronomy that is dependent on not only detecting such worlds, but also ascertaining that apparent signatures of habitability are not due to other sources. Space telescopes designed to observe such worlds, such as that recommended by NASA’s 2020 Astrophysics Decadal Survey, have a diffraction-limited resolution that effectively spreads light from a source in a region around the source point.

arxiv-2305-19087.title: An Optimization-based Approach To Node Role Discovery in Networks: Approximating Equitable Partitions
arxiv-2305-19087.creator: Michael Scholkemper, Michael T. Schaub
arxiv-2305-19087.description: Abstract Similar to community detection, partitioning the nodes of a network according to their structural roles aims to identify fundamental building blocks of a network. The found partitions can be used, e.g., to simplify descriptions of the network connectivity, to derive reduced order models for dynamical processes unfolding on processes, or as ingredients for various graph mining tasks.

arxiv-2405-06093.title: Selective Fine-tuning on LLM-labeled Data May Reduce Reliance on Human Annotation: A Case Study Using Schedule-of-Event Table Detection
arxiv-2405-06093.creator: Bhawesh Kumar, Jonathan Amar, Eric Yang, Nan Li, Yugang Jia
arxiv-2405-06093.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated their efficacy across a broad spectrum of tasks in healthcare applications. However, often LLMs need to be fine-tuned on task-specific expert-annotated data to achieve optimal performance, which can be expensive and time consuming. In this study, we fine-tune PaLM-2 ( Anil et al.

arxiv-2409-05320.title: Stratified dispersal explains mountain pine beetle’s range expansion in Alberta
arxiv-2409-05320.creator: Evan C. Johnson, Micah Brush, Mark A. Lewis
arxiv-2409-05320.description: Abstract Abstract 1. The mountain pine beetle (MPB), a destructive pest native to Western North America, has recently extended its range into Alberta, Canada. 2. Predicting the dispersal of MPB is challenging due to their small size and complex dispersal behavior.

arxiv-2502-09663.title: DiffEx: Explaining a Classifier with Diffusion Models to Identify Microscopic Cellular Variations
arxiv-2502-09663.creator: Anis Bourou, Saranga Kingkor Mahanta, Thomas Boyer, Valérie Mezger, Auguste Genovesio
arxiv-2502-09663.description: Abstract In recent years, deep learning models have been extensively applied to biological data across various modalities. Discriminative deep learning models have excelled at classifying images into categories (e.g., healthy versus diseased, treated versus untreated). However, these models are often perceived as black boxes due to their complexity and lack of interpretability, limiting their application in real-world biological contexts.

arxiv-2504-04572.title: Multimodal Lengthy Videos Retrieval Framework and Evaluation Metric
arxiv-2504-04572.creator: Mohamed Eltahir, Osamah Sarraj, Mohammed Bremoo, Mohammed Khurd, Abdulrahman Alfrihidi, Taha Alshatiri, and Mohammad Almatrafi, Tanveer Hussain
arxiv-2504-04572.description: Abstract Precise video retrieval requires multi-modal correlations to handle unseen vocabulary and scenes, becoming more complex for lengthy videos where models must perform effectively without prior training on a specific dataset. We introduce a unified framework that combines a visual matching stream and an aural matching stream with a unique subtitles-based video segmentation approach.

arxiv-2512-03895.title: Parameter efficient hybrid spiking-quantum convolutional neural network with surrogate gradient and quantum data-reupload
arxiv-2512-03895.creator: Luu Trong Nhan, Luu Trung Duong, Pham Ngoc Nam, Truong Cong Thang, Luu Trong Nhan
arxiv-2512-03895.description: Abstract The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) and deep learning (DL) has catalyzed the emergence of several optimization-driven subfields, notably neuromorphic computing and quantum machine learning. Leveraging the differentiable nature of hybrid models, researchers have explored their potential to address complex problems through unified optimization strategies.

britannica-1911-gerstenberg-heinrich-wil.title: Gerstenberg, Heinrich Wilhelm von (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-gerstenberg-heinrich-wil.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-gerstenberg-heinrich-wil.description: Article 'Gerstenberg, Heinrich Wilhelm von' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 11), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. German poet and critic, was born at Tondern in Schleswig on the 3rd of January 1737. After studying law at Jena he entered the Danish military service and took part in the Russian campaign of 1762. He spent the next twelve years in Copenhagen, where he was intimate with Klopstock.

pmc-10584659.title: Developmental Trajectory of Conduct Problems Among Boys and Girls Receiving Psychoeducational Services at Elementary Schools
pmc-10584659.creator: Michèle Déry, Caroline E. Temcheff, Martine Poirier, Stéphanie Boutin, Mélanie Lapalme, Annie Lemieux
pmc-10584659.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Elementary public schools remain the most common venues for addressing children’s severe conduct problems. Nevertheless, very few longitudinal studies have examined association between receiving psychoeducational services for conduct problems in school and subsequent conduct problem severity. This study explored if psychoeducational service reception contributed to reduce conduct problems in a sample of 434 elementary school-aged boys and girls presenting a high level of conduct problems. The study used a repeated measures design at 12-month intervals, for 4 years.

pmc-10620083.title: Seasonal advance of intense tropical cyclones in a warming climate
pmc-10620083.creator: Kaiyue Shan, Yanluan Lin, Pao-Shin Chu, Xiping Yu, Fengfei Song
pmc-10620083.description: Intense tropical cyclones (TCs), which often peak in autumn1,2, have destructive impacts on life and property3–5, making it crucial to determine whether any changes in intense TCs are likely to occur. Here, we identify a significant seasonal advance of intense TCs since the 1980s in most tropical oceans, with earlier-shifting rates of 3.7 and 3.

pmc-10628586.title: Case report: Herbal treatment of neutropenic enterocolitis after chemotherapy for breast cancer
pmc-10628586.creator: Peng Xu, Chaoxiong Cui, Yukun Liu, Kun Fang, Qitang Wang, Chao Liu, Ruixia Tan
pmc-10628586.description: In this case report, a 53-year-old woman was diagnosed with severe NE after receiving chemotherapy for breast cancer. The patient with breast cancer was treated with a single cycle of docetaxel (140 mg) + epirubicin (130 mg) + cyclophosphamide (0.9 g) chemotherapy.

pmc-10694556.title: Integrative approaches based on genomic techniques in the functional studies on enhancers
pmc-10694556.creator: Qilin Wang, Junyou Zhang, Zhaoshuo Liu, Yingying Duan, Chunyan Li
pmc-10694556.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). With the development of sequencing technology and the dramatic drop in sequencing cost, the functions of noncoding genes are being characterized in a wide variety of fields (e.g. Enhancers are noncoding DNA elements with vital transcription regulation functions. Tens of thousands of enhancers have been identified in the human genome; however, the location, function, target genes and regulatory mechanisms of most enhancers have not been elucidated thus far.

pmc-10748499.title: Response of leaf functional traits to soil nutrients in the wet and dry seasons in a subtropical forest on an island
pmc-10748499.creator: Juanjuan Zhang, Minxia Liang, Sen Tong, Xueting Qiao, Buhang Li, Qiong Yang, Ting Chen, Ping Hu, Shixiao Yu
pmc-10748499.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). IntroductionIsland ecosystems often have a disproportionate number of endemic species and unique and fragile functional characteristics. However, few examples of this type of ecosystem have been reported.MethodsWe conducted a comprehensive field study on Neilingding Island, southern China.

pmc-11504852.title: Effects of Dietary Net Energy Concentration on Reproductive Performance, Immune Function, Milk Composition, and Gut Microbiota in Primiparous Lactating Sows
pmc-11504852.creator: Fang Gu, Lei Hou, Kaiguo Gao, Xiaolu Wen, Shuyun Mi, Guoxi Qin, Lijun Huang, Qiwen Wu, Xuefen Yang, Li Wang, Zongyong Jiang, Hao Xiao
pmc-11504852.description: Simple SummaryIncreased reproductive performance in modern high-yielding sows often results in inadequate energy intake. Many recent studies have focused on the improvement of sow energy intake through the addition of different dietary energy source, but there have few studies on dietary energy concentration based on the net energy system.

pmc-11661463.title: Tubastrine, an antioxidant molecule from Tubastraea tagusensis sun coral, in the reversion of oxidative stress and neuron's death induced by Aβ42
pmc-11661463.creator: Amanda G Silva, João Vitor Cerávolo Rostirola, Filipe Duo Speri, Juliana Guanaes Pina, Marcelo V Kitahara, Giovanna B Longato, Juliana M Sciani
pmc-11661463.description: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder involving mitochondrial dysfunction and consequent production of reactive oxygen species (ROS), generated after amyloid peptide (Aβ42) accumulation. In this study, we isolated a new antioxidant molecule from the sun coral Tubastraea tagusensis and analysed it in cells exposed to oligomeric amyloid‐beta peptide 1‐42 (oAβ42).

pmc-11669092.title: Installing a Trigger to Upcycle High-Density Polyethylene
pmc-11669092.creator: Tianhao Nan, Quan Chen, Zhangfan Zheng, Yuxin Liang, Yufei Qin, Yanhui Wang, Bo Liu, Dongmei Cui
pmc-11669092.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Creating C=C bonds as “weak” sites in the stable C–C chains of polyethylene (PE) is an appealing strategy to promote sustainable development of the polyolefin industry. Compared to methods, such as dehydrogenation and postpolymerization modification, the copolymerization of ethylene (E) and butadiene (BD) should be a convenient and direct approach to introduce C=C bonds in PE, whereas it encounters problems in controlling the composition and regularity of the copolymer due to the mismatched activities and mechanisms between the two monomers.

pmc-12613946.title: 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing of seamount sediment microbial communities in South China Sea
pmc-12613946.creator: Haizhou Li, Huaiyang Zhou
pmc-12613946.description: Information about the microbiota in deep-sea seamount sediments is important because the microbiota and their activities in sediments affect deep-sea ecosystems. To evaluate deep-sea seamount microbial diversity, we performed 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing on sediment samples from 10 stations in the South China Sea.

pmc-13240330.title: Self‐Efficacy, Self‐Care, Glycaemic Control, and Quality of Life Among Adults With Type 2 Diabetes: A Scoping Review
pmc-13240330.creator: Omar Alqaisi, Faten Harb, Safia Darwish, Mohammed Dibas, Suzan Gharib, Patricia Tai
pmc-13240330.description: IntroductionType 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) is no longer just a metabolic diagnosis; it is a daily test of confidence, endurance and quality of life. Traditional measures such as haemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) provide only a partial picture, while patients' beliefs about their ability to manage diabetes may be equally crucial.

pmc-13380221.title: Semi-automated, evidence-based workflow for selection of reference chemicals for the validation of NAMs: a case study with the adipogenesis assay
pmc-13380221.creator: Hana C.M. Farnezi, Sander B.I. Lentz, Juliette Legler, Jorke H. Kamstra
pmc-13380221.description: Highlights•AI-assisted chemical selection provides an objective, standardized, and time-efficient chemical selection methodology.•The approach was tested using adipogenesis (in vitro) as a surrogate measure for adiposity (in vivo) as a case study.•A scalable framework was developed that is adaptable to other New Approach Methodologies (NAMs).•Candidate chemicals were identified as suitable for further in vitro validation of adipogenesis.

pmc-13465661.title: Mindfulness, psychological resilience, and cognitive reappraisal on athletic performance: a predictive model based on psychological mechanisms
pmc-13465661.creator: Cheng Xing, Zainal Abidin N E, Aman M S
pmc-13465661.description: BackgroundMindfulness is increasingly viewed as a psychological resource for athletic performance, yet the sequential mechanism through which mindful awareness is translated into performance through cognitive reappraisal and psychological resilience remains insufficiently examined. This study constructed and tested a predictive model linking mindfulness, cognitive reappraisal, psychological resilience, and perceived athletic performance among competitive university athletes.

pmc-13640019.title: Evolution of right ventricular contraction patterns of adult heart transplant recipients by three-dimensional echocardiography
pmc-13640019.creator: Yuji Xie, Wei Sun, Linyue Zhang, Yanting Zhang, Shuangshuang Zhu, Yun Yang, Xin Zhang, Sushan Xiao, Liqiong Shi, Qing Lv, Yuman Li, Chun Wu, Li Zhang, Mingxing Xie
pmc-13640019.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe right ventricular contractile pattern is altered after heart transplantation (HT). This study aims to use three-dimensional echocardiography (3DE) to comprehensively assess right ventricular contractile pattern in HT patients.MethodsIn a cohort of 200 adult HT recipients, we serially assessed 3DE RV contraction patterns—including global (RVEF), longitudinal (LEF), radial (REF), and anteroposterior (AEF) ejection fractions—from the early post-operative period to 3 years. 50 HT patients were compared to matched healthy controls and open-heart surgery patients.
